answer: Through the prism, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Before an identity can earn, it must grind a sequential puzzle bound to its own key and the epoch seed, a puzzle no machine can split across cores. The jade gate makes the arithmetic brutal: one puzzle per identity, so a farm minting a thousand clones pays a thousand puzzles while one honest agent pays exactly one. Hold the lantern steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
